project_title: Base to Starknet USDC Auto-Bridge Wallet
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & ELECTRIC NEON (DeFi Command Center)

principles: Tactical Depth over Flatness: Staked tonal depth (#05070A -> #0C1017 -> #141A24) with crisp 1px borders
Real-time Intent Visibility: Clear visual status pipeline showing Base Deposit -> Bridge Relayer -> Starknet Settlement
Instant Actionability: One-click fresh deposit address creation, auto-generated QR codes, instant copy buttons
Zero-Clutter Information Hierarchy: Key stats (Slippage, Bridge Provider, Fee, Estimated Time) cleanly exposed without noise

monospace.font_family: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8

inputs: Starknet Destination Address (0x... format with validation & visual jazz icon)
Amount Input (USDC amount on Base, auto calculates expected USDC received on Starknet)
Bridge Provider Selector Toggle (Layerswap vs NEAR Intents)
actions: Generate Deposit Address Button (creates new dynamic single-use deposit address on Base bound to user's Starknet destination)

features: Display generated Base USDC deposit address in highlighted code box
Copy to Clipboard button with visual toast feedback
Interactive SVG / Canvas QR Code generator for mobile wallet scanning
Explicit instructions: 'Send Base USDC only to this address. Funds will be auto-swapped to Starknet USDC.'

live_status_tracker.realtime_feedback: Animated pulse ring, timer duration counter, Base scan link & Starknet scan link

features: Search by Address or Swap ID

details: Raw Intent Payload & JSON View toggle

interactive_states_and_animations.hover: hover:border-cyan-500/50 hover:bg-slate-900/80 transition-all duration-200 shadow-lg shadow-cyan-950/20

animations.pulse_dot: animate-ping inline-flex h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 opacity-75

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure file path /app/design_guidelines.json is respected and correctly written.
Use JavaScript / React (.js files) as per prompt requirements.
Import Lucide icons (lucide-react) for visual indicators: ArrowRightLeft, Copy, Check, ExternalLink, RefreshCw, ShieldCheck, Zap, Fuel, Layers, AlertCircle.
Use sonner for instant copy and transaction status notifications.
All interactive elements MUST contain appropriate data-testid attributes.
Implement real backend endpoints or mock fallback API handlers so the user can test instant deposit address creation, auto-polling transaction status updates, and history list persistence.
